description: SASRec predicts the next item using causal self-attention over interaction histories. Learned item and position embeddings pass through attention and feed-forward blocks with residual connections, normalization and dropout. Candidate scores are dot products with shared item embeddings. Training uses next-item binary cross-entropy with sampled negatives. [Paper](https://arxiv.org/html/1808.09781)
motivation: Attention lets the model select relevant past interactions, balancing recent transitions with longer-range preferences across sparse and dense histories. SASRec is a sequential recommendation baseline; its learned item IDs do not directly solve unseen-item cold start. [Source](https://arxiv.org/html/1808.09781)
implementation_notes: Start from RecHarness sasrec_perdataset and retain Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics and CDs_and_Vinyl routing. Preserve preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], trial-local artifacts and the SASREC_EPOCHS default of 200. Select using macro validation HR@10 under the pinned host evaluator. Preserve DiagnosisProbe(view, device).run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), returning metrics and metric_definitions, and adapt its compatibility view to the trained model. Any architecture change must update the predictor writer. Use only permitted public data; unavailable review fields and simulator traits cannot support probes. No benchmark improvement has been established.
pseudocode:
For each category:
  Load the unchanged benchmark split.
  Form padded histories and shifted next-item targets.
  Encode histories with causal SASRec blocks.
  Optimize positive/negative BCE at non-padding positions.
  Save weights and architecture configuration beneath the trial directory.
Generate working/predict.py with matching model loading and category routing.
Use host validation macro HR@10 for trial selection within the shared GPU budget.

originality.positive: The original paper introduced an influential attention-based approach to sequential recommendation.
originality.negative: The supplied idea specifies the existing SASRec baseline and benchmark constraints without a new cold-start mechanism.

future_potential.positive: Permitted titles and descriptions could support a future content-based extension for sparse items.
future_potential.negative: Such an extension remains a hypothesis requiring validation within the fixed search budget.

code_difficulty.positive: The existing per-dataset SASRec implementation provides the required starting point.
code_difficulty.negative: Architecture changes require consistent checkpoint loading, predictor generation, routing and diagnostic adaptation.
